exempt.FlockJsonDifftestMain: the flock-json-difftest server's entry point, one line: Difftest.serve of FlockJsonDifftest.table, which tests/test_flock_json_port.py drives against the Python mirror; audited under FlockJsonDifftest (a root beside DifftestExample, which declares `main` too)
exempt.FirewallHonestDifftestMain: the firewall-honest-difftest server's entry point, one line: Difftest.serve of FirewallHonestDifftest.table, which verity/protocols/flock/prover/tests/test_honest_reqs.py drives against rec_live's requests; audited under FirewallHonestDifftest
exempt.AnnotDifftestMain: the annot-difftest executable's entry point, one line: Difftest.serve AnnotDifftest.table, audited under AnnotDifftest; a root of its own would put a second `main` beside DifftestExample's

Difftest.why: the harness is code: Lean core and C-Flock's canonical JSON, no Mathlib and nothing of Security (Daniel's layout ruling, 5 Oct)

DifftestExample.why: the example port reaches Lean only through the harness, as a port does

FlockJsonDifftest.why: C-Flock's JSON parser's port reads the parser it holds to its Python mirror, and Lean core's parser through the harness

FirewallHonestDifftest.why: the honest worker's requests' port reads C-Flock's Flock.Firewall.honestReqs and what the firewall's load check takes, through the harness

AnnotDifftest.why: the annotation check's port reaches Lean through the harness and C-Flock's Flock.Annot and its per-gate reference, as a port does
